technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum and trend confirmation (ADX, supertrend, DC10 breakout) offset by overbought conditions, price below key moving averages, and negative volume signals; moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: NEE shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 60 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite weak congressional selling signal; no recent news sentiment available to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (384.96) with flat yield curve and negative macro score create severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 60 days adds moderate event risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX strong trend confirmation + supertrend bullish + DC10 new high breakout create short-term momentum setup with extreme fear sentiment offering contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all key moving averages (EMA21, EMA50, SMA200), overbought oscillators (StochRSI, Williams %R), negative volume (CMF, AO), zero fundamental conviction, and crisis-level VIX (384.96) in severely unfavourable macro environment make this a high-risk fade of momentum into headwinds.

decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX (384.96) and severely unfavourable macro environment create systemic headwinds that will likely overwhelm short-term technical momentum; earnings in 60 days add uncompensated event risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
